summary: Monday: Islamabad peace talks collapse — Trump orders Hormuz naval blockade starting 10 AM ET. Oil surges 7% past $100. Goldman Sachs beats Q1 (EPS $17.55) but dips -3% on FICC miss. PPI March at 8:30 AM. JPM/WFC/BLK earnings tomorrow. BTC breaks $74.4K (+4.7%). Trump threatens 50% China tariff. Shortened week (Good Friday). Crypto Fear at 8 — 49-day streak.

risks.label: Hormuz Naval Blockade (Day 1)
risks.detail: CENTCOM blocks all vessels entering/exiting Iranian ports starting 10 AM ET Monday. Islamabad talks collapsed on nuclear enrichment, Hormuz sovereignty, and Hezbollah. IRGC vows retaliation. Oil +7% to $98-104. If Iran retaliates, oil goes to $120+ and recession risk spikes.

risks.detail: Trump threatened to raise tariffs on China to 50% (from 47.5%) after reports of Chinese air defense shipments to Iran. Trump-Xi summit May 14-15 at risk. Section 301 comments due April 15.
